title: Independent workers with Git-coordinated immutable handoffs

nodes.constraint: Depth-conditioned variants require an explicit additional bootstrap dependency.
Consumes original prepared export, source video, aligned mesh and CoCoNet/refined native bundles; never an arbitrary SceneState.

Pinned decoder/converter normalization before atomic scene publication; preserve raw artifacts. Native08 is a side job, not an import dependency. No automatic quality acceptance or selected-scene promotion.
Serialize the exact normalized scene; no new fitting and no native 08 call.
Requires execution-valid baseline and frozen observations; preserves baseline.
Serialize the exact validated candidate parameters; no new fitting and no native 08 call.

coordination.common_packages: Frozen inputs downloaded once; each delta names exact required package hashes.
coordination.dependency_completeness: Declared JSON refs and actual native adapter file-read dependencies, including binary metadata paths, must resolve and verify across all packages; unknown dependencies are rejected.
coordination.git_byte_policy: Canonical manifests need fixed byte/newline treatment.

stage_result_proposal.producer_record_lifecycle: Immutable after producer publication; contains no archive self-hash or future receiver receipt.
stage_result_proposal.transport_manifest_location: Outside the archive whose bytes it hashes.
stage_result_proposal.receiver_lifecycle: Publish separately after verification; never mutate producer or transport records.

proposed_operations.pack: Reconcile JSON refs and adapter-enumerated actual native file reads; verify closure and then publish external TransportManifest.
proposed_operations.verify: Reject unsafe paths, missing, stale or unknown dependencies, mismatched hashes and disallowed provenance.
proposed_operations.import: Quarantine, verify and apply semantic checks before immutable registration; publish separate ReceiverReceipt and never promote.

invariants: One logical native run identity links all native stage results.
Publish one complete coherent scene atomically after native dependency validation.
Normalize raw native MHR to authoritative pose136/shape45/scales68 before scene publication; preserve raw artifacts and conversion error.
Native 08 renders raw native bundles only; baseline/candidate renderers decode the exact authoritative SceneState.
Official serialization never independently refits or changes an already normalized scene.
Stage adapters enumerate actual binary metadata and file-read dependencies beyond JSON refs; reject unknown dependencies.
Producer StageResult, external post-pack TransportManifest and receiver verification/relocation receipt remain separate immutable records.
Keep standalone bootstrap distinct from native recomputation.
Native 01-04 require real metric asset and complete prepared export.
Do not create fake meshes or forged wild_export markers to break the bootstrap cycle.
Human-only native export is a future adapter, not a capability assumed by this profile.
Preserve original path-bearing files; rewritten local views receive new hashes and relocation records.
Do not treat copied stage/cache markers as cross-machine execution evidence.
No synchronized locks, selections, mutable latest inputs or shared network ArtifactStore.
Import never grants trust to producer reports or changes acceptance flags.
Scientific pins are shared; reviewed stage runtime environments may differ.
Each required object retains every original source frame, including occlusion.
current_gaps: Main runtime remains v1 fake stages.
Native adapters and source/model/runtime restoration are not accepted.
Current v2 validators do not enforce a multi-host native stage sequence.
Artifact transport closure, streaming IO, relocation and coordinator checks are unimplemented.
Existing release restore wrapper accepts only named historical releases.
Real decoder/conversion, quality and export acceptance remain open.

rollout_goals_after_resource_confirmatio.goal: Freeze interfaces and pins; build local pack/verify/import with synthetic two-root failure tests.
Transfer native 01-04 to a second host, execute native 05, test relocation and transfer onward to 06-07.
Complete one full episode on two hosts, preserve native08 preview, normalize with conversion evidence, atomically publish, serialize/reload/decode/render the exact scene; repeat on second episode.

fallback: Co-locate adjacent native stages on a capable worker while preserving package interfaces and independent module work.
